Hi Elena — thanks, and welcome aboard. Quick summary of options so finance can pick the path that best fits Archwell's AP setup: 

1) Portal-first (recommended for most customers)
- Redwood Console exposes invoice PDF + line-item metadata via API and SFTP export.
- We can invite an AP admin so invoices are visible immediately and retained according to your policy.
- Optionally we send email copies (PDF) to invoices@archwell.eu for teams that need a mailbox replica.

2) E-invoice push (Peppol / XML)
- We can push a structured invoice XML (sample attached) to a Peppol ID or to an SFTP endpoint.
- This is preferable if your ERPs consume structured invoices directly.

3) Email-only (manual)
- We can send PDF copies to any addresses, but this is less automatable and not recommended for high volume.

What we need from Archwell to proceed with either portal or e-invoice:
- Preferred delivery method (Portal / Peppol / SFTP / Email)
- AP contact (name + invoices@ address)
- Confirm VAT ID and legal billing entity (you listed NL123456789B01 — please confirm legal name)
- Preferred invoice reference fields (PO, contract id, usage period)

Next steps I propose: 
- If Peppol: Marcus will follow up with onboarding checklist and bank/SEPA instructions.
- If Portal: I'll send an admin invite and API/SFTP details, and we can enable automatic email copies.

Attached: sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml (example payload), vendor_setup_form.pdf (you sent).

If you can confirm delivery method and the AP contact, we can schedule a short onboarding call this week.

Best,

— Soojin Lee

Hi all — looping in finance details. We support both delivery methods but have slightly different requirements per method: 

- Peppol / e-invoice XML push: we can send to your Peppol ID or to an SFTP endpoint. We require the receiving party's Peppol ID or SFTP credentials and the field mapping for invoice lines.
- Portal/API/SFTP pull: we can enable an SFTP export or provide API endpoints; AP admin will need an account with read-only invoice access. We can also configure recurring push to your SFTP (daily).

Default terms we plan to use unless you specify otherwise: Net 30; invoices will include PO and usage window (UTC timestamps). We need the following to complete setup:
- Official billing legal name to print on the invoice (as appears on your VAT registration)
- Billing address for SEPA/VAT purposes
- Bank details if you prefer remittance info to be prefilled on PDFs

Attachment: sample_invoice_xml_v2.xml (preview of the XML we send).

If Archwell can accept Peppol, that will be the cleanest for automated ingestion. If not, portal + SFTP pull is next best.

— Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Systems | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
